title: Another animal dumping site surfaces in Bulacan as probe into pet crematorium continues
summary: A third site containing dumped animal remains has been discovered in San Jose del Monte City, raising further questions about the disposal of pets entrusted to a crematorium in Bacoor, Cavite.
